correctness_reconciliation.strict_bound: For every dropped set D and destination j, abs(sum_D Wq[j,i]) <= sum_D abs(Wq[j,i]) <= sum_D exact_beta_i <= sum_D U_i <= B.

route_classification.new_selection_semantics: Natural source order with skip-and-continue greedy filling; a source that does not fit is kept, while a later smaller code can still be dropped.
route_classification.performance_requires_repack: Without lookahead/repack, gated lanes are bubbles on the legacy K8 timeline and speedup is exactly 1.0 before the negligible metadata prefetch. M367 performance models therefore add a new 8-active-word to eight-bank queue compactor.
route_classification.finding: This is an M341-uncovered execution route within the same cumulative-budget family, not yet an independent paper contribution.

scope_recompute.finding: Neither FC1 nor the selected Conv hides a >=1.15x implementable B512 sub-scope.

unpriced: eight 4-bit metadata read address muxes or true multiport RF cost
eight dependent 11-bit add/compare/select greedy stages at target frequency
8x8 source-ID route, per-bank prefix counts and atomic-word skid state

hardware_cost_audit.finding: The cheap 8-bank 1R memory is decisively too slow; the 8R model is port-expensive and still fails the speed gate before timing or area are charged.

p1.title: The best cycle models are CPU timestamp recurrences over an unproven active-list frontend and compactor
p1.impact: Eight arbitrary beta reads, the eight-lane dependent greedy chain, atomic multi-enqueue routing and tagged K8 issue are not RTL or timing-proven. This does not weaken the NO-GO because even the strictly more optimistic combinational/unbounded model peaks at only 1.106350x.

p2.title: b0_exact is populated true on nonzero rows
p2.impact: Only the B0 row has B0 identity semantics. The validation receipt and README correctly prohibit citing this field on B16-B1024.

p2.title: B0 retains scan and metadata-conflict population diagnostics
p2.impact: They are correctly excluded from all B0 totals but should be renamed diagnostic_if_enabled or set to zero in a future schema.

p2.title: The 4.0x metadata ratio excludes runtime porting and queue state
p2.impact: Adding only eight 1R scratch copies and D8 payload raises the visible ratio to 4.028355x; mux, control and tags remain unpriced.

p2.title: The finite queue model accepts or stalls a whole eight-ID word atomically
p2.impact: A partial-accept compactor could trade smaller FIFOs for more control, but D16 nearly equals the infinite registered result and neither approaches 1.15x, so this cannot reverse the decision.

p2.title: The error proof is raw INT8 accumulator-local, not accuracy
p2.impact: B512 observes raw error up to 508. No nonzero point has valid825 evidence, and performance fast-kill makes A800 evaluation unjustified.

verdict.reopen_threshold: A materially new route must first show <=5,810,153,280 selected-scope cycles at B<=512 under finite metadata ports, queues and the same accumulator/context resources given to baseline. It must then pass A800 valid before RTL.
